evidence.name: Screen field: Where the image starts on screen
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Where the image starts on screen" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Where the image starts on screen
sections.description: Sets the top edge of your image or video. Screen Top runs it all the way up behind the status bar and header for a full-bleed, edge-to-edge hero. Header Bottom starts it just below the header bar so a back button or progress bar stays clearly visible. Pick Screen Top for an immersive opener, Header Bottom when the header needs to read cleanly.
